channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Chris Duarte | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Chris Duarte from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Mike Brown on Chris Duarte, Sasha Vezenkov
item.description:
Mike Brown:

“I’m excited for Sasha (Vezenkov), I’m excited for Chris Duarte, I’m excited about our young guys. It’s good to have the new guys, but I’m more excited about having our guys to be able to run it back and give them the opportunity to grow as a nucleus than anything else.”

Mike Brown on Chris Duarte, Sasha Vezenkov, Aug 28, 2023. Source: Fox40.com.

item.title: Rick Carlisle on Chris Duarte
item.description:
James Boyd:Rick Carlisle on Chris Duarte, who’s missed three straight games due to a sore left big toe:

“He (practiced) some. I hope he can play tomorrow. I don’t know that it’s for sure yet, so we’ll hope for the best. He is doing better. He’s been making daily progress.”

Rick Carlisle on Chris Duarte, Feb 26, 2022. Source: Twitter @RomeovilleKid.

item.title: Nick Nurse on Chris Duarte
item.description:
Raptors head coachNick Nurse:

“(Chris) Duarte is playing really well and I think people have underrated him, obviously. We need to give him the attention he deserves.”

Nick Nurse on Chris Duarte, Oct 27, 2021. Source: Twitter @ScottAgness.

item.title: Chad Buchanan on Chris Duarte
item.description:
GM Chad Buchanan on Duarte:

“Great work ethic... great toughness. He's a guy we've tracked over the last 2 years. His shooting has improved. His ball handling has improved. He may be 24 years old but he started playing basketball as a teenager.”

Chad Buchanan on Chris Duarte, Jul 29, 2021. Source: Twitter @ThisIsJMichael.

item.title: Rick Carlisle on Chris Duarte
item.description:
J. Michael Falgoust:Carlisle on Duarte:

“I think he's got a great chance to crack our rotation right off the bat ... He was more of a finished product than a lot of the guy sin the draft. His athleticism is underrated. At 6-6 he has length, speed and quickness.”

Rick Carlisle on Chris Duarte, Jul 29, 2021. Source: Twitter @ThisIsJMichael.
